Definition: a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim
BiblicalUsage: A Bacharumite is a man of Bahurim, and the one named is Azmaveth the Baharumite, among David's mighty men. A man known by his town, and by the king he served.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God remembers the mighty men by their towns as well as their names, because every one of them stood for the king.
